jordan (AE): Heads-up: Orion LOI is conditional on capacity + security signoff. They expect short spikes ~1.2k qps (60-90s), steady ~250 qps. Workload: ~70% chat (avg ~1.2k tokens, max 3k rare), 30% single embeddings. SLO: chat p95 < 250ms. They want reserved baseline + burst autoscale.

sam (SE): quick clarifier: embeddings batched client-side? and is p99 a hard req?

jordan (AE): embeddings not batched by default. p99 is soft (<1s preferred).

maya (SRE): presales sizing idea: reserved baseline = 8 H100-equivalent nodes for steady state, burst pool prewarmed to ~80 nodes for short spikes. KV cache warmup + preheat cron essential. Autoscale rules: aggressive scale-up, 15-20m cool-down. Sample policy: reserved=8, burst_max=80, preheat_secs=60.

chris (eng-infra): ops notes: instant cold adds spike tail for ~30-90s. Recommend pre-allocated burst credits or spot-backed burst with cross-AZ fallback; enforce per-client queue limits to avoid noisy-neighbor impact.

liz (finance): ballpark cost: 8 H100-class reserved ~ $104k/mo committed. Burst billed on usage; offer tiered discount on 12/24mo terms. Need model/quantization choice to tighten numbers.

noah (security): blocker items from questionnaire: CMK support (customer-managed keys), SAML SSO, EU region pinning for logs. Dedicated + private control plane acceptable but we need to validate KMS/HSM flow.

capacity-bot: Created presales ticket PS-5001 and linked runbook template.

jordan (AE): thanks. @sam @maya please produce 1-page POC config (FP16 / 8-bit / 4-bit cost/latency deltas), KV warmup steps, and pricing delta table by EOD tomorrow. I'll share with Orion after that. :thumbsup:
